id.description: The unique identifier for the plugin

supportsEventSubscription.description: Whether the plugin supports event subscription

capabilities.description: List of capabilities supported by the plugin

displayName.description: Human-readable display name from plugin metadata (populated when expand=metadata)

icon.description: Icon identifier from plugin metadata (populated when expand=metadata)

authType.description: Authentication type from plugin metadata (populated when expand=metadata). "API_KEY" accepts a single API key; "API_KEY_ENDPOINT" accepts both an API key and a custom endpoint URL (used for OpenAI-compatible providers where users bring their own base URL); "QR_CODE" uses an access-code + QR code scanning flow (e.g., Tuya Smart app).

capabilityInterfaces.description: Capability interfaces from plugin metadata (populated when expand=metadata)
